_comment: FROZEN CONTRACT, shared by the Elowen package and the plugin registry. The cron/schedule grammar is hand-mirrored in three implementations that cannot import one another: the cronjob plugin's parseSchedule (the authority, and what validates API writes), web/lib/cronSchedule.ts (web validation) and web/lib/cron.ts (the dashboard's next-run computation). Since the plugin moved to the registry, no test can hold all three at once — so each side pins itself to THIS file instead. Widening the grammar means changing it here, in BOTH repositories, deliberately.
